verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents local model running, a chat UI, MCP client support, a REST API, a CLI, headless mode and the Bionic agent. Nothing shows user-definable rules that trigger actions automatically on events. On-demand model loading when a request arrives is a fixed built-in behavior, not a user-configurable rule system, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
